brief.goal: a 3D-printed folding phone stand: two 70x66x6mm plates joined along one edge by a knuckle hinge (6mm knuckles) turning on a 1.75mm pin 55mm long, so it folds flat to 12mm thick and opens into an A-frame that holds a phone
brief.design: Slim, clean desk accessory. The two plates should read as one matched pair with identical edge treatment: about 1 mm fillets on the outer plate edges and corners, crisp internal hinge faces so the knuckles nest tightly, and no decoration beyond the phone groove. The plates should feel solid and flat, so the folded stack is a tidy slab.

back-plate.title: Back plate (rear leg)
back-plate.spec: 70x66x6 rectangular plate, the rear leg of the folding phone stand. Along its +y edge it carries the odd knuckles of a 5-knuckle hinge: knuckles 1, 3 and 5 counting along x. Each knuckle is a Ø6 barrel coaxial with the hinge axis, centred on the plate's top face and inset so it stays inside the 66 mm depth. Where the front plate's knuckles 2 and 4 sit, the edge strip is cut fully away so those knuckles can rotate through it.

contract.name: Back plate
contract.summary: 70x66x6 plate. The hinge axis runs along x at y = depth/2 - knuckleDia/2, level with the top face (z = +thickness/2). This plate owns the centre knuckle and both end knuckles of a 5-knuckle, 55 mm hinge. The top face is the inner face when folded.

params.name: depth
params.description: plate length away from the hinge (y)

params.name: knuckleDia
params.description: outer diameter of the hinge knuckle barrels

params.name: hingeSpan
params.description: total length of the knuckle row, equal to the pin length

provides.description: +x end face of the centre knuckle; the front plate's knuckle 4 turns against it

artifact.code:
from build123d import *
import math


def build(p):
    W = p.width
    D = p.depth
    T = p.thickness
    kd = p.knuckleDia
    kr = kd / 2.0
    span = p.hingeSpan
    gap = p.knuckleGap

    kl = (span - 4 * gap) / 5.0          # knuckle length
    ay = D / 2.0 - kr                     # hinge axis y
    az = T / 2.0                          # hinge axis z (top face)
    x0 = -span / 2.0

    starts = [x0 + i * (kl + gap) for i in range(5)]

    # base plate with ~1 mm rounded vertical corners
    plate = Box(W, D, T)
    plate = fillet(plate.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), 1.0)

    # clear the edge strip where the front plate's knuckles 2 and 4 rotate
    cut_r = kr + gap
    y_lo = ay - cut_r
    y_hi = D / 2.0 + 1.0
    for i in (1, 3):
        xa = starts[i] - gap
        xb = starts[i] + kl + gap
        cutter = Pos((xa + xb) / 2.0, (y_lo + y_hi) / 2.0, 0) * Box(xb - xa, y_hi - y_lo, T + 2.0)
        plate = plate - cutter

    # odd knuckles 1, 3, 5
    for i in (0, 2, 4):
        xc = starts[i] + kl / 2.0
        plate = plate + Pos(xc, ay, az) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(kr, kl)

    # pin bore through knuckle 5 so the pin tip ends free (no fusing)
    pin_d = 1.75
    bore_r = pin_d / 2.0 + 0.225
    xc5 = starts[4] + kl / 2.0
    plate = plate - Pos(xc5, ay, az) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(bore_r, kl + 2.0)

    # integral hinge pin stub from knuckle 3's +x face, 11.52 long
    pin_len = 11.52
    px0 = starts[2] + kl
    pin = Pos(px0 + pin_len / 2.0, ay, az) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(pin_d / 2.0, pin_len)
    plate = plate + pin

    # clip groove on the pin
    gx = px0 + kl + 0.17
    gw = 0.34
    groove = Cylinder(pin_d / 2.0 + 0.3, gw) - Cylinder(1.2 / 2.0, gw + 0.2)
    plate = plate - Pos(gx, ay, az) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * groove

    return plate

front-plate.title: Front plate (phone rest)
front-plate.spec: 70x66x6 rectangular plate, the front leg and phone rest of the stand. Along its -y edge it carries the even knuckles of the 5-knuckle hinge: knuckles 2 and 4 counting along x, each a Ø6 barrel on the hinge axis, level with the top face. The edge strip is cut away where the back plate's knuckles 1, 3 and 5 sit. A straight ledge groove runs the full width across the bottom (outer) face near the free +y edge, and the phone's lower edge rests in it.

contract.name: Front plate
contract.summary: 70x66x6 plate. The hinge axis runs along x at y = -(depth/2 - knuckleDia/2), level with the top face (z = +thickness/2). This plate owns knuckles 2 and 4 of the back plate's 5-knuckle row. A phone ledge groove crosses the -z (outer) face near the +y free edge.

params.name: depth
params.description: plate length away from the hinge (y)

params.name: ledgeWidth
params.description: width of the groove the phone's bottom edge sits in; set it to your phone's thickness with case

params.name: ledgeDepth
params.description: how deep the phone groove cuts into the plate

params.name: ledgeOffset
params.description: how far the phone groove's centre sits in from the free edge

requires.description: -x end face of knuckle 4, turning against the back plate's centre knuckle

artifact.code:
from build123d import *
import math

def build(p):
    W = p.width
    D = p.depth
    T = p.thickness
    lw = p.ledgeWidth
    ld = p.ledgeDepth
    lo = p.ledgeOffset

    ya = -D / 2 + 3.0   # hinge axis y
    za = T / 2          # hinge axis z (level with top face)
    rk = 3.0            # knuckle radius
    rc = 3.4            # clearance cut radius for mating knuckles
    rb = 2.05 / 2       # pin bore radius
    L = 55.0
    seg = L / 5.0
    cl = 0.24

    # base plate with rounded vertical corners (before any cuts)
    plate = Box(W, D, T)
    plate = fillet(plate.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), 1.0)

    # remove the square edge strip above the axis line across the hinge length
    plate = plate - Pos(0, ya - 2.0, za - 1.5) * Box(L + 1.0, 4.0, 3.0)

    # even knuckles (2 and 4)
    k_ranges = [(-1.5 * seg + cl, -0.5 * seg - cl), (0.5 * seg + cl, 1.5 * seg - cl)]
    for x0, x1 in k_ranges:
        kl = x1 - x0
        knuckle = Pos((x0 + x1) / 2, ya, za) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(rk, kl)
        plate = plate + knuckle

    # clear the gaps where the back plate's knuckles 1, 3, 5 sit
    gaps = [(-L / 2 - 0.5, -1.5 * seg + cl), (-0.5 * seg - cl, 0.5 * seg + cl), (1.5 * seg - cl, L / 2 + 0.5)]
    cutters = []
    for x0, x1 in gaps:
        gl = x1 - x0
        cutters.append(Pos((x0 + x1) / 2, ya, za) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(rc, gl))
    plate = plate - cutters

    # pin bore through the knuckles
    plate = plate - Pos(0, ya, za) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(rb, L + 1.0)

    # phone ledge groove across the bottom face near the free +y edge
    yg = D / 2 - lo
    plate = plate - Pos(0, yg, -T / 2) * Box(W + 2.0, lw, 2 * ld)

    return plate

hinge_pin_clip.title: hinge pin clip
hinge_pin_clip.spec: printed Ø1.75 pin pivot, e-clipped. Catalog DIN 6799 (key is the groove Ø d2) 1.2, built by the registry, never generated.

joints.note: Knuckle hinge on a 1.75 mm pin (a 55 mm length of 1.75 mm filament) through all five knuckles. Travel 0 is open flat with the plates on opposite sides of the axis. Limits are left out so expansion derives the clear range from the envelopes; the A-frame opening sits inside it.
